title: Overdetermined problems for the rotationally invariant Poisson equation in model manifolds
summary: We present rigidity results for overdetermined problems associated to the rotationally invariant Poisson equation $-Δ_{g_\mathcal{M}} u = f(r)$ in a model manifold $\mathcal{M} = [0,S) \times_h \mathbb S^{N-1}$ with warping function $h$. The variable $r$ ranges in the interval $[0,S)$, whose endpoint $S$ is positive and possibly infinite.
